newsitem.title: USA: Globalization will keep budget deficits down - Rubin.
newsitem.headline: Globalization will keep budget deficits down - Rubin.

text.p: The United States and other nations no longer have the leeway to pursue overly lax budget policies for long because of the discipline imposed on them by world markets, Treasury Secretary Robert Rubin said on Monday.

"We have global financial markets that are not going to permit nations to get into the kind of fiscal laxity that we had in the early and mid-'80s," he said. "Nations that get into that position will be so severely punished that they're going to be forced back into a fiscally responsible position.
"You see that in Europe right now," Rubin continued, "as the European nations get into what they call congruence in order to put in place a common currency."
He made the comments to the House Judiciary Committee.
